REGISTRY_POSITION.what_is_true: nfl.rs.epa_logit_ridge.v0_2.shadow WAS built and preregistered and PASSED its retrospective gate (2,895 completed RS games with PBP; 1,865 walk-forward predictions 2019-2025; winner Brier 0.2298 vs 0.2497 expanding baseline; paired CI95 [-0.0261,-0.0137] over 124 season-week blocks; margin MAE 10.41 vs 11.14; total MAE 11.01 vs 10.98 NOT validated, CI crosses zero). Its disposition is VALIDATED_SHADOW_ARTIFACT / NO_PROMOTE / no live forecast authority / $0. v0_1.shadow exists as REJECTED_DO_NOT_USE under an append-only invalidation. What is separately true is narrower: the ACTIVE branch registry carries no NFL model, and its lineage is not restored — the recorded commits 1d089d45* and f3cf5b1d* resolve nowhere in local history or the current remote.
REGISTRY_POSITION.why_no_forecast_anyway: the registered scope of v0_2.shadow is REGULAR SEASON. Preseason was excluded at preregistration because planned QB and starter snap share and substitution intent are not reconstructible historically as pregame timestamped features. Every 8/28 game is preseason. The no-forecast outcome is unchanged; only the reason is corrected, from 'never built' to 'outside registered scope'.

competition_phase: PRESEASON_FINAL_WEEK — determined from nflverse/nfldata games.csv, which is authoritative for phase and structurally silent on preseason fixtures (0 August gamedays in any season)
dispositions: every row NO_FORECAST with null_reason PRESEASON_EXCLUDED_BY_REGISTERED_SCOPE. Brier, logloss and EV are NULL BY RULE, not by omission; PENDING is not used, because nothing is waiting to arrive.
market: NO_RETAINED_MARKET_ARTIFACT at freeze. Prices are never predictive features and enter only the action/EV overlay, which cannot open without a forecast.
